references.text: Same context regarding redemption rights and the Jubilee year; the verse explains what happens if a house in a walled city is not redeemed
Concerns the Levitical cities and their surrounding lands which cannot be sold, part of the same legislation on property rights
Fundamental text about the Jubilee (יֹבֵל) where all property must be returned
Similar provisions regarding fields and property in connection with the Jubilee year
Concerns cities given to the Levites with open villages (חֲצֵרִים) around them, using the same terminology for unwalled settlements
Describes walled cities (חוֹמָה) in contrast to unwalled villages (חֲצֵרִים)
